2607.03015.title: Beyond Forecasting: The Belief-to-Trade Layer in Prediction-Market Agents
2607.03015.paper_summary: Forecasting future events has attracted growing attention as a testbed for general-purpose AI. A natural way to ground this evaluation is let the models trade in the prediction markets. Trading, however, requires more than forecasting. Moreover, recent benchmarks report a substantial gap between calibrated probability scores and the trading results. We propose Raven-Agent, to the best of our knowledge, the first autonomous trading agent for prediction markets. On a controlled replay over an archived decision set, our architecture achieves the only positive return and the only positive risk-adjusted return among all tested policies. We have released our code in https://github.com/Alchemist-X/predict-raven .
2607.03015.paper_summary_zh: 預測未來事件已引起越來越多的關注，作為通用人工智慧的測試平台。將這一評估具體化的自然方式是讓模型在預測市場中進行交易。然而，交易需要的不僅僅是預測。此外，最近的基準報告顯示，經過校準的概率分數與交易結果之間存在顯著差距。我們提出了Raven-Agent，據我們所知，這是第一個用於預測市場的自主交易代理。在對存檔決策集的受控重播中，我們的架構在所有測試政策中實現了唯一的正回報和唯一的正風險調整回報。我們已在https://github.com/Alchemist-X/predict-raven上發布了我們的代碼。
